events.title: Demo Update: More Detailed Repairs & Reworked Bargaining!
events.summary: Hello everyoneThis update brings more detail to computer and phone repairs, revamps the bargaining system, and introduces a range of fixes to improve your experience.Repair ExperienceAdded thermal paste replacement: wipe off the old paste with a cloth, apply fresh paste with a syringe, and spread it with a spatula.Dusty parts now need to be cleaned with a dust cloth before removal.Screwdrivers, syringes, spatulas, cleaning cloths, and dust cloths can now be picked up directly from the desk.Held

events.title: Electronics Repair Shop Joins Steam Next Fest! 🔧
events.summary: Your shop. Your tools. Your repair business.Electronics Repair Shop is taking part in Steam Next Fest! Our demo is already available, so step behind the workbench and give it a try!🔧 Find faults and repair broken devices. 💰 Buy and sell used electronics. 🏪 Invest your earnings and grow your shop.Play the demo, tell us what you think, and add the game to your wishlist!What would you like to repair first: a phone or a desktop PC? Let us know in the comments!Vio Games Team

events.title: 🔧 Electronics Repair Shop Is Coming to Steam!
events.summary: Hi, future repair shop ownersWe’re excited to introduce Electronics Repair Shop, a repair and business simulation game where you fix broken devices, buy and sell used electronics, and grow your own shop.Start with a small workspace and get behind the repair bench. Find faulty components, bring devices back to life, and use your earnings to build your business.Our Steam page is now live, and our trailer is ready to watch!
